name: Karl Miller
fact: He was treasurer of Western's chapter of the Public Relations Students Society of America in 1990-91, serving under president Beth Struck and vice president Jeff Polson, with Michelle McIntire as secretary and Nina Kissinger as public relations director. He stands third from the left in the chapter's back row in the group photograph on the same spread.

src.label: 1991 Talisman, pp. 162 and 165, Public Relations Students Society of America; indexed "Miller, Karl 162, 165"

name: Alan Thomason
fact: He is in the Associated Student Government group photograph in the 1992 Talisman, named first in the front row, and a year earlier he appears in the Sigma Phi Epsilon photograph taken during the fraternity's recolonisation year, also named first in the front row.

src.label: 1992 Talisman, p. 180, Associated Student Government; 1991 Talisman, p. 222, Sigma Phi Epsilon

name: Kevin Colon
fact: The Talisman prints his surname with an accent, Colon. He was a freshman from Elizabethtown in 1991-92 and is named last in the second row of the Associated Student Government group photograph that year.

name: Susan Mitchell
fact: She is in the Student Government Association group photograph in the 1993 Talisman, named fourth in the front row, in the year she was Administrative Vice President. The 1993 index gives her two pages, 170 and 204, both organization pages, and no class portrait.

src.label: 1993 Talisman, p. 204, Student Government Association; indexed "Mitchell, Susan 170, 204"

name: Ginger Markham
fact: She was a Spirit Master in 1992-93, one of the students who acted as the university's ambassadors, and an Alpha Delta Pi member. Those two group photographs are the only pages the 1993 index gives her.

name: Patrick Monohan
fact: The Talisman spells him Monohan in all three volumes that carry him, never Monahan. He was a Spirit Master, one of the students who acted as the university's ambassadors, in both 1991-92 and 1992-93, and a member of Delta Tau Delta, which lists him as a senior in 1993-94.

src.label: 1992 Talisman, p. 181; 1993 Talisman, p. 202; 1994 Talisman, p. 66; indexed "Monohan, Patrick" in each

name: Kenny May
fact: The Talisman indexes him as Kenneth S. May and prints him as Kenny May and Kenny S. May. He was a sophomore from Elizabethtown in 1991-92, a member of Phi Beta Lambda that year, and of Sigma Alpha Epsilon by 1992-93, where he is named first in the chapter's front row.

src.label: 1992 Talisman, pp. 132 and 164; 1993 Talisman, p. 200; indexed "May, Kenneth S. 132, 164" and "May, Kenny 62, 200"

name: Heather Renee Meenach
fact: She was a Spirit Master in 1992-93, named second in the front row of that group's photograph, two years before the Fall 1994 membership list records her as a senior off-campus representative. The 1993 index gives her pages 144, 188 and 202, all feature or organization pages, and no class portrait.

src.label: 1993 Talisman, p. 202, Spirit Masters; indexed "Meenach, Heather 144, 188, 202"

name: Paige Pride
fact: She was a biochemistry major from Tell City, Indiana, and graduated in 1993. Besides Congress she belonged to the Order of the Omega honour society and the Student Alumni Association, whose Oozeball tournament produced the 1993 Talisman photograph that names her.

name: Laura Jo Bland
fact: She was a sophomore from Campbellsville in 1991-92 and a member of Western's Pre-Law Club, which sponsored the RONKIN seminar on applying to law school and preparing for the LSAT that the 1992 Talisman photographed her at.

src.label: 1992 Talisman, pp. 162-163, Pre-Law Club; indexed "Bland, Laura Jo 162"

name: William Zorn
fact: The Talisman prints him as William Zorn in the freshman grid and as Woody Zorn in captions. Besides the Student Government Association group photograph, where he stands in the second row, he was a member of the Forensics team in 1992-93.

src.label: 1993 Talisman, pp. 74, 184 and 204; indexed "Zorn, William 74" and "Zorn, Woody 184, 204"

name: Jason F. Gerst
fact: He was a member of Delta Tau Delta, and the 1994 Talisman photographed him caked in mud after the Delt tug team beat Alpha Gamma Rho in the Greek Week tug competition.
